script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The moon is under her feet; the text does not say her feet are on it.
Both signs appear in heaven, but the text does not say the dragon appears right alongside the woman.
The pastry-degree joke mentions a food outside the cookie-only rule.
The text states what the dragon is ready to do, not that he has no interest in the moon.
The text says the child was caught up to God, but does not state that the dragon never gets his hands on him.
The text does not say the dragon gets nowhere near the child; it says he stood before the woman.
Calling the wilderness empty adds a detail the text does not give.
Daniel 1:1 describes Nebuchadnezzar besieging Jerusalem, not taking its people into exile.
The text does not say the woman returns from the wilderness or makes a trip home.
The text does not say the dragon hands over nothing; it says he is hurled down.
The voice names the word of their testimony but does not specify here what they say in that testimony.
The text names how they conquered; it does not say they have no strength of their own.
The cookie-box joke does not match the action it is comparing: lifting boxes is not conquering an accuser.
Being given the wings does not establish that she did not earn or build them.
The text says she flies to the wilderness, but does not say she does not hide.
Calling Michael an angel needs a reference outside this passage, such as Jude 1:9.
The passage says no place was found for the dragon in heaven, but does not say a return fight cannot happen.
The text does not state that the lack of a place in heaven is why the dragon does not return to fight Michael.
